title: Laser treatment of the retina
what: The doctor uses a laser to make tiny spot welds on the retina. This strengthens it or seals off unhealthy blood vessels.
why: For retinal tears and thinning, retina changes from diabetes, and some blood vessel conditions of the eye.
duration: usually 10 to 30 minutes, about 1 to 1.5 hours with preparation
tell_doctor: All your medicines and eye drops

prepare.title: Getting there
prepare.text: Your pupil will be widened, so you cannot drive afterward. Come with someone.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You can usually eat beforehand, unless the clinic says otherwise.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop your regular medicines on your own.

steps: The eye is numbed and the pupil widened with drops
You sit at the machine and rest your chin on a stand
A special lens is placed on your eye
The doctor aims the laser, and you see bright flashes
Look where the doctor tells you and keep still
The lens is removed, and the eye is rinsed
feel: Sometimes tingling or an aching feeling
Afterward, blurry vision for a few hours
after: Do not drive until your vision is back to normal
No heavy lifting or sudden bending for the first days, if your doctor says so
Come for your follow-up on time
red_flags: Suddenly many new floaters, flashes, or a curtain over the eye: see an eye doctor urgently
Severe eye pain, or headache with nausea: call emergency services

faq.q: Will the laser improve my vision?
faq.a: Usually its goal is to protect your vision and stop it getting worse.

faq.q: Will it need to be repeated?
faq.a: Sometimes several sessions are needed. Your doctor will say.

reminders.text: Retinal laser tomorrow. Arrange a ride home and bring sunglasses.
